log.text: Merged PR #56 and PR #57 (ML-TASK-026 parts A and B; 1792 tests, 53 e2e, CI green). Phase 2 complete. Wrote the G2 review package (PR #58).
Decided ML-TASK-026: keep 1,000,000 samples as the hard limit, add a soft warning above 250,000; deterministic maneuver ids derived in apps/web (no contract change).
Reviewed the performance record: sound with notes, no blocking finding; all medians recomputed from the raw JSON match. Notes N1–N7 applied to performance-envelope.md (PR #57).
Bounded review of the ML-TASK-026 performance record started (Sonnet): method, medians recomputed from raw data, honesty of the envelope, the limit recommendation, the worker timing hook.

ML-TASK-026 part A: 18/18 measured runs 1e3…1e6 samples (engine ~1.4 µs/sample, transfer ≤ 3.2 ms, responsive during runs, ~0.5 s geometry pause and <3 fps software-WebGL playback at 1e6); proposed limit: keep 1,000,000; VI-01 integration test added; model panel readability fixed. Deterministic maneuver ids blocked: no counter field in the Scenario schema.

ML-TASK-026 part A started (Sonnet): reproducible performance harness (1e3…1e6 samples, ≥ 3 repetitions), performance-envelope.md with a Proposed limit, G2 evidence list, deterministic maneuver ids (contracts §14), model-panel readability.
Merged PR #55 (status). Wrote the ML-TASK-026 contract: part A measures and proposes, part B sets the limit after the owner decides.
Approved the not-qualified statement wording; PR #53 and PR #54 merged (merge commits), CI green.

Merged 024 and 025 on one branch without conflicts; all checks pass (1779 tests, 52 e2e); Hermite hand case re-checked; screenshot reviewed and sent. Follow-ups noted: deterministic maneuver ids (contracts §14), readability of long model-panel texts. PR #54.

ML-TASK-024 (playback, Hermite display interpolation exact at samples, one t_s for read-out and marker) and ML-TASK-025 (model panel from SimulationResult.model, sentinel test, not-qualified statement) delivered.

ML-TASK-024 (timeline, playback, Hermite display interpolation within a segment, exact at samples) and ML-TASK-025 (model panel rendered from SimulationResult.model, sentinel test, not-qualified statement) started in parallel, Sonnet.
Merged PR #52 (status). Wrote the ML-TASK-024 and 025 contracts.

Merged PR #49 (ML-TASK-027), PR #50 (ML-TASK-022 + 023 workspace) and PR #51 (status) on the owner's go-ahead; CI green. PR #50 first failed CI on a camera e2e race (camera not yet registered); fixed by polling, assertions unchanged.

Checked the integration branch: all checks pass, 1738 tests, 42 e2e; only apps/web, the lockfile, simulation (027) and task YAMLs changed; no Date arithmetic left in apps/web. Derived values in the screenshot match hand values (period 5828.5 s, energy −28.47 km²/s² for a = 7000 km). Screenshots sent to the owner.

Integrated 022 + 023 on the 027 API: scene in the centre region, derived panel and degeneracy from describeScenarioOrbit, angle normalisation, UTC label and ERA from the engine, browser VI-02 on a maneuvered scenario (0 mismatches).

Checked ML-TASK-027 (1677 tests, scope packages/simulation only). Recomputed the ERA test values in 40-digit decimal; the hand values were 1e-11 rad off under a 1e-8 tolerance, so the test now asserts 5e-13 (5e-11 for the daily advance). Push failed: github.com does not resolve from this network. Integration of 022 + 023 on 027 started (Sonnet).
ML-TASK-027 delivered after resuming from the usage limit: DEGENERACY_THRESHOLDS (ADR-008), ENGINE_CONSTANTS, describeScenarioOrbit, utcIsoAtElapsed, earthRotationAngle_rad; 47 new tests.

ML-TASK-023 delivered: three/R3F scene, scale 1e-6 per metre, VI-02 exact (Object.is on 918 components across 3 scenarios, 0 mismatches; a 1.0000001 scale mutation fails 4 tests), display options never run, 9 e2e pass. Reference radius and ERA arithmetic moved to ML-TASK-027.

ML-TASK-027 started (Opus): expose through packages/simulation the approved degeneracy thresholds, a scenario-orbit description (normalised angles, derived quantities, degenerate class and convention) and a UTC label of epoch + t_s, so apps/web computes no physics and the boundary stays as approved.

ML-TASK-022 delivered partly: layout A, editor, maneuver, banner + chip, keyboard; 26 e2e pass. Blocked on FR-002 AC2–AC4 because the needed functions are only in packages/astrodynamics, which apps/web may not import (ADR-002); nothing was reimplemented.
OA-15 decided (option 1): the Wakker assessment is published without any value from the book; ML-TASK-012 closed (PR #48).

ML-TASK-022 (layout shell, editor, field validation, maneuver, keyboard) and ML-TASK-023 (three/R3F scene, exact Math.fround(x·s) vertices, VI-02 hook) started in parallel, Sonnet, separate worktrees.
Approved the visual direction: layout A, blue accent, result state as banner plus chip. Recorded in visual-direction.md and design-tokens.md (PR #47).
Confirmed the default scenario values and the error-state rule of ML-TASK-021; PR #45 merged (merge commit), CI green.
Checked ML-TASK-021: all checks and 4 e2e pass, only apps/web, lockfile and task YAML changed; breaking current→stale failed 6 web tests (reverted). PR #45 opened.
ML-TASK-021 delivered: zustand store, five-state result machine, engine in a module worker (latest run wins), VE-02 and ML-UX-003 e2e (max frame gap 16.8 ms during a 600 001-sample run).
ML-TASK-021 started (Sonnet): zustand store, five-state result machine (ML-UX-001/002), engine in a Web Worker with transferred typed arrays, VE-02 e2e.
Merged PR #43 (G1 follow-ups) and PR #44 (status, roadmap page). Wrote the ML-TASK-021 contract on the owner's go-ahead.

Published a visual project roadmap (docs/status/roadmap.html, artifact claude.ai/artifact/RvGTjBWkJS7kDqBkkg7xkc). G1 follow-ups delivered in PR #43: restarted-arc procedure, verification plan amended for the VT-17 deferral, task statuses.
G1 follow-ups started (Sonnet): restarted Orekit arc procedure, verification plan amended for the VT-17 deferral, stale status lines and task YAML statuses.
Merged PR #41 (G1 report, approved, ID ML-VER-008; G1-review.md decision record) and PR #42 (status), CI green.

Approved gate G1 as recommended: VT-17 and VT-18 FR-011 AC3 deferred to G3; reduced scopes and L3 gaps accepted; datasets, Orekit files and verification reports approved unchanged at 77cdbaa; O-1 and O-2 closed; G1 report approved. Recorded in docs/releases/G1-review.md.
Checked the G1 report branch (only the report and task YAML changed) and confirmed the VT-17 plan/backlog conflict (plan §8 requires VT-17 at G1; backlog puts it in ML-TASK-033). PR #41 opened.

G1 verification report delivered: 1574 tests pass locally and in CI; all quoted ratios reproduced. G1 not met as worded (VT-17 untested); recommends passing on owner conditions. Nine inconsistencies listed, not fixed.
G1 verification report started (ML-TASK-018 final part, Opus): verdict per G1 criterion, evidence layers per family, L3 gaps, CI status, open items and owner approvals needed.
Accepted IERS Conventions 2010 (TN36) as the VT-19 source for G1; WGS 84 attribution stays an open gap. PR #40 merged, CI green.
Re-ran the VT-19 test (4 passed). Confirmed the NGA site is unreachable from this network (curl and browser time out; other hosts fine). PR #40 opened.

VT-19 delivered: GM and reference radius bit-equal to IERS TN36 Tables 1.1/1.2; ERA coefficients string-equal to TN36 Eq. 5.14. NGA.STND.0036 unreachable; WGS 84 attribution and GM atmosphere variant not verified.
VT-19 started (ML-TASK-011 remainder, Sonnet): μ and reference radius against NGA.STND.0036 (WGS 84), ERA coefficients against IERS Conventions 2010, with a bit-equality test of the engine constants.
Merged PR #39 (switch removal, heavy-test timeout, status) on the owner's go-ahead; CI green.

Removed the revision-5 switch as specified (N5): the hyperbolic suites now run in every pnpm test; record lock kept. Added a 60 s test timeout to the verification and conformance projects (no assertion changed). Full suite passes locally: 1570 tests, 0 skipped. PR #39.
Accepted conformance run 4; PR #37 (merge commit) and PR #38 merged, CI green.

Checked run 4: re-ran the gated conformance project (614 passed); branch changes only the restart data, the report and the task YAML. Local full suite hits Vitest 5 s timeouts on 2 pre-existing heavy verification tests (also on main; CI passes). PR #37 opened.

ML-TASK-018 D3 phase 2 delivered (conformance run 4): extended O-1 check 546 samples (worst 0.083), hyperbolic states vs L2b and restarted Orekit (worst 0.0033), Orekit selfcheck 500 + 495 checks, 0 failures; all three §4.1 item 6 conditions in one run. O-12 and O-13 proven.
ML-TASK-018 D3 phase 2 started: c1 restart, Orekit selfcheck on both restart directories, extended O-1 check (546 samples) and asserted hyperbolic states in one run.
Owner approved tolerance record rev. 5; §15 rows and status signed in b60a06a. Merged PR #35 (merge commit), CI green.

Checked the rev. 5 review fixes: all checks pass (1415 passed, 156 gated skipped), allowed paths only, the gate still refuses without the approval line. Agreed with the author on N4 (approved L3 VT-12 row, 1.972e-10 m/s, recomputed). Pushed to PR #35.

Rev. 5 review notes N1–N7 applied (10 commits): O-1 grid extended to 144 cases / 546 samples near the 0.05 gate, same-run condition enforced in code, c1 event-state premise asserted, gate accepts any approved revision ≥ 5.

Applying rev. 5 review notes N1–N7: O-1 grid extended to cover the inbound/outbound arcs, same-run condition, superseded fields, c1 event-state premise asserted, gate after approval, stale text, sub-surface grid note.

Bounded review of rev. 5: approve with non-blocking notes. δt_α,hyp re-derived and checked by finite difference (≤ 4e-39); B_tof sensitivity re-derived and tested with 400 random perturbations (worst 0.95 of bound); 20 values recomputed, all match; gate verified by reading; no tuning, no loosening. Seven non-blocking notes.
Bounded review of tolerance record rev. 5 (PR #35) started at the owner's request: hyperbolic δt_α, extended O-1 check, the time-of-flight bound B_tof, §4.1 item 6, the c1 restart and the gate.

Checked D3 phase 1: all checks pass (1366 passed, 108 gated skipped), allowed paths only, Orekit generator and datasets unchanged; with the switch set the gated files refuse to load without the approval line. PR #35 opened.

ML-TASK-018 D3 phase 1 delivered: record rev. 5 (hyperbolic δt_α and O-1 check on 498 samples, A6′ hyperbolic criterion, §4.1 item 6), selfcheck 500/500 with worst hyperbolic ratio 9.6e-4, gated phase-2 tests not run.

ML-TASK-018 D3 phase 1 started: tolerance record rev. 5 (hyperbolic δt_α and extended O-1 check, O-12), pass/fail hyperbolic checks in the Orekit selfcheck (O-13), gated tests not run against the engine until the owner signs.
Merged PR #33 (conformance run 3, merge commit) and PR #34 (status) on the owner's go-ahead; CI green. Owner chose to close O-12/O-13 before the G1 report.

Checked run 3: all checks pass (1248 tests), allowed paths only, existing builder changed only by exports, phase-2 commits touch no reference or test. Moving one Orekit VT-02 position by 3e-6 m (tolerance 8.29e-7 m) failed exactly that test; restored. PR #33 opened.

ML-TASK-018 D2 delivered: conformance run 3, 74 new tests, 0 failures. New versions vt-15-r4 and vt-16-r4; engine vs Orekit L3 on VT-02, 05, 12, 15, 16 (worst ratio 0.034). Hyperbolic states informative (O-12, O-13). Orekit selfcheck re-run: 489/489.

ML-TASK-018 D2 started: conformance run 3 (new L2 dataset versions for VT-15 and hyperbolic VT-16 per §4.1 item 5; engine vs Orekit L3 for VT-02, 05, 12, 15 and elliptic VT-16). Phase 1 committed before any engine run.
Owner approved tolerance record rev. 4; §15 rows signed and status set in commit 2f7e6fd. Merged PR #31 (merge commit) and PR #32 (status), CI green.

Checked the rev. 4 review fixes: only the two allowed files changed, format passes, §4.1 item 5 and the B1 rule present, χ²C coefficient 8, the C3 value 1.595e-14 recomputed (143.7u). Pushed to PR #31.
Rev. 4 review fixes done (6 commits): B1, B2 (§4.1 item 5), B3 (inbound 2.2341e-5 m, outbound 1.2691e-5 m, matching the reviewer), C3 loosening withdrawn, N1, N2, N4, N3 wording.

Applying review fixes to rev. 4: B1 mode A at m > 0 only for apsis-tangential burns; B2 new dataset versions for re-evaluated run-2 cases (§4.1 item 1); B3 hyperbolic χ²C coefficient 7 → 8; keep the approved C3 values (no loosening); N1, N2, N4.

Bounded review of rev. 4: changes required. 31 values recomputed independently, all agree; r_max substitution tested independently (model bounds the true sensitivity with wide slack). Blocking: B1 mode-A rule for non-tangential burns at m > 0; B2 values re-evaluated on datasets already run (§4.1 item 1); B3 missing subtraction rounding in the hyperbolic χ²C row. The C3 loosening is not forced. P-4 authority sufficient; 0.05 threshold safe.
Bounded review of tolerance record rev. 4 (PR #31) started at the owner's request: new derivations, four independent recomputations, the loosening, the P-4 authority and the 0.05 proposal.

Checked rev. 4: only the two allowed files changed; the P-4 clauses exist in ADR-005, contracts §5.2 and ML-TASK-015; L3 VT-02 C1 is 1.5000× the L2 value; the C3 loosening recomputes to +0.073 %. New formulas not re-derived. PR #31 opened.

ML-TASK-018 D1 delivered: tolerance record rev. 4 (Proposed). VT-09 exact, VT-14 e = 0 for G1, VT-15 general burns and plane angle, VT-16 hyperbolic budget with 10κ_E·r_max, L3 rows for VT-02/12/15/16. All numbers evaluated twice (binary64 and 50-digit decimal).

ML-TASK-018 part D1 started: tolerance record revision 4 (P-1 VT-14 e = 0 only for G1; P-2 non-tangential burns; P-3 hyperbolic budget; P-4 close O-4; Orekit rows for VT-02, VT-12, VT-15, VT-16). No engine run until the owner approves it.
Approved the recommendations for tolerance gaps P-1…P-4.
Merged PR #29 (Orekit L3 datasets, merge commit) and PR #30 (status) on the owner's go-ahead; CI green on both.
Owner decided the L3 datasets stay in `test-data/l3-orekit/`; contract paths amended. Opened PR #29 (ML-TASK-012 part B).

Checked ML-TASK-012 part B: all repository checks pass (1153 tests), only contract paths touched, scripts committed before data, `selfcheck.py --repro` reproduced (489 checks, 0 failures, byte-identical regeneration). A 1e-9 change to one stored velocity made 2 self-checks fail; file restored.

ML-TASK-012 part B delivered: 43 Orekit datasets (VT-02 9, VT-05 9, VT-12 8, VT-15 14, VT-16 3), no orekit-data needed. Orekit and L2a agree to 1.1e-5 m over 10 periods (tolerance 1.6e-3 m). Location conflict with two inventory tests reported.
ML-TASK-012 part B started: Orekit L3 reference datasets (VT-02, VT-05, VT-12/15, VT-16) with self-checks, in its own worktree.
Merged PR #27 (conformance run 2, merge commit) and PR #28 (status) on the owner's go-ahead; CI green on both.

ML-TASK-018 part C delivered: independent RSW, maneuver and grid references; 67 datasets; 254 new conformance tests, 0 failures (worst ratio 0.071). Coordinator re-ran everything (1153 tests), checked the phase order and showed a 1e-9 perturbation of one reference makes its test fail. Four gaps without approved tolerance reported. PR #27.
ML-TASK-018 part C was stopped by the account usage limit during phase 1 (references and datasets); its worktree and two commits survived. Resumed from there.

PRs #25 and #26 merged on the owner's instruction after CI passed (PR #25 needed a close/reopen because GitHub did not start CI on its last pushes); issue #24 closed; `main` passes 867 tests. ML-TASK-018 part C started (Verification, opus): references and datasets first, committed before the engine is looked at, then conformance tests.

ML-TASK-019 delivered: the propagator fails explicitly on a rectilinear fall to the centre (exact zero angular momentum, analytical collision time) and the runner reports it as a failed run; −0 normalised in the request builder. Coordinator re-ran all checks (867 pass, 124 conformance tests unmodified), audited the three changed tests and recomputed the fall time. PR #26.

Decided issue #24: the propagator returns an explicit failure when a rectilinear trajectory reaches the centre within the requested time. ML-TASK-019 started (Astrodynamics, opus): that fix plus the approved −0 normalisation; the normal path must stay bit-identical.

Approved the runner's points P1–P10 as recommended (provisional sample limit, intersection warning at the maneuver time, −0 normalised in the request builder as a follow-up) and instructed the merge of PRs #22 and #23 after CI passed. Recorded in contracts-v1.md §11.4. ML-TASK-017 done; `main` passes 829 tests.

ML-TASK-017 delivered: semantic validation, request builder with in-repo SHA-256 (constants computed from their definition, NIST vectors), normative sampling grid, runner with segments, maneuver event, warnings and metadata; 100 new tests. Coordinator re-ran all checks (829 pass) and reproduced an engine defect the agent reported: a rectilinear fall is propagated through the centre with status ok (issue #24). PR #23.
ML-TASK-017 started (Astrodynamics, opus): simulation runner in `packages/simulation`.

Approved the eight escape / surface-intersection design choices (D1–D8) and instructed the merge of PRs #20 and #21 after CI passed. Recorded as contract revision 4 (§8.3, §11.3) and an amendment to ML-FR-006 AC6. `main` passes 729 tests.

ML-TASK-016 delivered: RSW basis, impulsive maneuver with bit-exact velocity update, analytical escape and reference-sphere intersection flags; 63 new tests (self-consistency only). Coordinator re-ran all checks: 729 tests pass. PR #20.

PRs #18 and #19 merged on the owner's instruction after CI passed; `main` passes 666 tests and 20/20 boundary fixtures. ML-TASK-016 started (Astrodynamics, opus), one Opus task at a time from now on because of the usage limit.

ML-TASK-018 parts A/B delivered: `conformance/` workspace with ADR-009 and 20 boundary fixtures; first run of the engine against the 55 datasets: 124 tests, 0 failures, worst error 1.5 % of tolerance on propagation and 9.4 % of the solver threshold. Coordinator re-ran everything (666 tests) and showed a 1e-9 perturbation of one reference makes its test fail. PR #19 (opened after a network outage on the dev machine).

Approved a new `conformance/` workspace for engine-versus-reference tests (may import engine, contracts and verification code; nothing imports it). ML-TASK-018 part A/B started (Verification, opus): workspace, ADR-009, boundary fixtures, then the first conformance run with tolerances already fixed.

ML-TASK-018 not started: the approved package boundaries leave no place for tests that import both the engine and the verification code (`verification/` may import only contracts; the engine imports nothing). Raised to the owner instead of working around it.

Instructed the merge of PRs #14–#17 and approved the retrograde-equatorial convention (substitute angles in the sense of motion), now in ADR-008 with the approved threshold and target values. Coordinator resolved the export conflict between #15 and #16; `main` passes 542 tests.

ML-TASK-011 delivered: three independent references (matrix construction, Kepler-equation propagation, RK4 with step halving), in-repo 320-bit arithmetic, the solver-check evaluator and 55 datasets with evaluated tolerances; engine neither read nor run. Coordinator re-ran all checks: 418 tests pass. VT-19 still open. PR #17.

ML-TASK-011 (independent references, Verification, opus) was stopped by the account usage limit shortly after starting; nothing had been saved. Resumed in a fresh worktree with instructions to commit after every piece.

Approved the tolerance record (revision 3): angular accuracy target 1e-5 rad, degenerate thresholds 1e-5, corrected solver-check threshold. Approval recorded in §15; PR #12 merged after CI passed. ML-TASK-010 done.
ML-TASK-010 revision 3: second-review corrections applied, no tolerance value changed; the solver-check threshold now includes a derived allowance for the α data error. Ready for owner approval.

Bounded second review of PR #12: every recomputed value matches; B1–B3 resolved; the record stays a valid conservative standard for the propagator's consistent g form. One substantive correction (the O-1 solver check would also measure a separately budgeted error and could fail a correct engine at high eccentricity) and three wording fixes. Verification Engineer resumed for revision 3.

Chose a bounded second review of the tolerance record before approval. Architect (opus) started: solver budget derivation, recomputation of changed values, and whether the record still holds for the propagator's consistent g form.

ML-TASK-015 delivered: Stumpff functions and universal-variable propagator, no warm start, noise-floor stopping criterion with diagnostics; 45 new tests (self-consistency only). Agent-measured time residual at most 7.5 % of the proposed solver budget. Coordinator re-ran all checks: 420 tests pass. PR #16.

ML-TASK-014 delivered: element ↔ state conversion with ADR-008 conventions, atan2-only angle extraction, hyperbolic states supported, orbit quantities; 79 new tests (self-consistency only). Coordinator re-ran all checks: 454 tests pass. Its first worktree was lost in the usage-limit interruption and the task was redone from scratch. PR #15.

ML-TASK-010 revision 2: solver residual budget derived (24.8u to 74.6u at ten periods); an undercounted off-orbit error found and added; propagation tolerances loosened (VT-05 at LEO 1.47e-5 → 2.60e-5 m); break-even table shows margins of ×4.5 to ×10 over the budget. Not yet re-reviewed.
The three running agents (ML-TASK-010 revision, ML-TASK-014, ML-TASK-015) were stopped by the account's usage limit on 2026-11-12 and resumed from their saved work.
Started ML-TASK-014 (element/state conversion, atan2-based extraction required) and ML-TASK-015 (universal-variable propagator, no warm start, stated stopping criterion) in parallel worktrees.

Instructed the merge of PRs #10, #11 and #13 after CI passed: constants and vector math, contract revision 3, ADR-008. `main`: 375 tests pass. ML-TASK-008 and ML-TASK-013 done (VT-19 still open against the WGS 84 standard itself).
ML-TASK-008 delivered: ADR-008, contract revision 3 (no schema change, `schemaVersion` stays 1.0), amendments to ML-FR-003 and ML-FR-007, VT-13 wording. PR #13.

Approved four decisions: e and i are never forced to zero; angular accuracy target independent of display formatting (value to be approved with the tolerance record); first sample of every segment bit-identical to its initial state (contract revision 3); scene coordinates as one multiplication plus one Float32 rounding. ML-TASK-008 started (Architect, opus).

Review of PR #12: approve with changes. About 20 evaluated tolerances recomputed and matched. Blocking: the solver residual budget is assumed rather than derived and leaves VT-06/07 with little real margin; re-evaluation rules must respect ADR-003; VI-03 must not use the module under test as its own reference. Revision started.

ML-TASK-010 delivered: tolerance record with error models, formulas and evaluated values for VT-01…VT-16 and VI-02/03, margin 4; ten open items (solver criterion, atan2 extraction, degenerate thresholds, display resolution…) and four requirement-wording conflicts. Citations unconfirmed. PR #12; Architect review started.

ML-TASK-013 delivered: constants with cited source and 3-vector / 3×3 math, 37 new tests. Coordinator re-ran all checks (375 tests pass) and independently read GM and the semi-major axis in the cited NGA document. The WGS 84 standard itself (TR8350.2) was not reachable, so VT-19 stays open. PR #11.
Phase 1 started in isolated worktrees: ML-TASK-010 tolerance derivation (Verification, opus) and ML-TASK-013 constants, units and vector math (Astrodynamics, opus).
Instructed the merge of PRs #7, #8 and #9 after CI passed. Contracts v1.0 approved. Phase 0b exit criterion met: CI passing, `main` protected, contracts approved.
GitHub Actions recovered. CI passes on PR #8 and PR #9; PR #7 re-triggered with an empty commit because its run stayed stuck.

Owner approved the install. Dev machine: Python 3.13.17 (user scope) and Eclipse Temurin JDK 21.0.13 via winget; virtual environment at `C:devmission-lab-toolsorekit-venv` with `orekit-jpype` 13.1.9.0 and JPype1 1.7.1. Smoke test: JVM starts and Orekit classes load. No orbit computed yet.

ML-TASK-012 part A delivered: Wakker's textbook assessed from its text layer only (formulas and figures not readable). Verdict: good citation source for closed-form relations, weak L3 (few examples, 3–5 significant digits). Committed locally, not pushed pending the owner's decision on publishing book values.

ML-TASK-004 delivered: zod schemas and types for Scenario, Request and Result, code registry, `contracts-v1.md`; 120 tests pass (re-run by the Coordinator). 5 additive deviations and 8 open questions for the owner. PR #7 open.
